name: Dual-Tier Desk Shelf & Monitor Stand
description: An extendable two-level desk shelf that lifts your monitor to eye level and frees up space underneath for your laptop, keyboard and essentials.

name: Triple Laptop Screen Extender
description: Two fold-out screens that clip onto your laptop and turn it into a three-screen workstation. Plugs in with USB-C and folds flat to take anywhere.

name: Cordless Heated Lunch Box
description: A battery-powered lunch box that warms your food anywhere — at the office, in the car or on a picnic. No socket needed, with a digital display and timer.

name: Cordless Bladeless Fan with Ambient Light
description: A quiet, rechargeable bladeless fan with a soft ambient night light. No blades to clean, no cable needed — move it from desk to bedside to car.

name: Magnetic Laptop Phone Mount
description: A slim aluminium mount that attaches to the side of your laptop screen and holds your phone magnetically beside it. Perfect as a second screen for calls, chats or notes, and folds flat to carry anywhere.

specs.Fits: Phones and small tablets, 3–8 inch, all brands

name: Rechargeable Outdoor Fan with LED Light Ring
description: A tough, cordless fan with a built-in LED light ring and a huge 20,000 mAh battery. Built for camping, the beach, the car or power cuts at home, with a carry handle to take it anywhere.

name: Portable Countertop Ice Maker
description: Fresh ice cubes in minutes, anywhere you have power — at home, in the majlis, on the boat or at the camp. Just add water, press start and scoop.

name: Portable Baby Bottle Warmer
description: Warm milk to the perfect temperature anywhere — in the car, at the mall or on a trip. A rechargeable, cordless bottle with a digital temperature display, ready whenever your baby is.

name: Portable Rechargeable Blender
description: Fresh smoothies, shakes and baby food wherever you are. A slim, cordless blender with a carry strap that fits in your bag, car cup holder or gym locker.

specs.Features: Low noise, easy to clean, carry strap

name: Electric Salt & Pepper Grinder
description: One-touch grinding for salt, pepper and spices, at the table or the barbecue. A sleek stainless steel grinder with a clear chamber so you always see what's inside.
